summary: Genenta Science S.p.A., an Italian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that by order dated October 2, 2026, notified October 5, the Court of Milan denied in full minority shareholders' application for interim suspension of the capital increase approved by the Board on May 18, 2026, tied to the ATC S.r.l. acquisition and the June 29, 2026 shareholder meeting appointing the Board. The capital increase and share issuance remain effective pending merits proceedings and any appeal. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or recommendation stated. Watch Italian litigation risk and appeal timing as the overhang.
